messages:
Lina (compliance): Auditor follow-up: they want proof that after the RBAC change we redacted PII before export, that exported logs were envelope-encrypted with KMS, that each exported file has a SHA256 in a signed manifest, and that vuln-triage links CVEs to commits + IR ticket 2026-IR-47. Can we assemble artifacts by EOD?

Maria (sec-eng): I will prepare redaction rules, sanitized samples, manifest.jsonl (per-file JSON lines) and a GPG-signed manifest. Quick Q: per-file hashes or single bundle hash?

auditor_jones: Per-file SHA256s please. Include exporter identity, exported-at timestamp, KMS key id & version, and evidence redaction ran before export (replayable test harness).

Ajay (infra): I ran the export to s3://redwood-compliance/exports/2026-03-20-rbac-window/. Command used for trace: `aws s3 cp --recursive /var/log/processed/ s3://redwood-compliance/exports/2026-03-20-rbac-window/ --metadata exported-by=ajay,exported-at=2026-03-20T15:10:00Z`. Each object was envelope-encrypted with KMS arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/abcd-1234 (version=3). I computed sha256 per .log.enc and appended JSON lines to manifest.jsonl, then signed with our GPG key.

Sam (sec-ops): Note: RBAC change created svc-rw-data and svc-metrics; we rotated their credentials during the window. IR ticket 2026-IR-47 (token leak alert) contains timeline. I will attach iam-change.diff and rotation logs to the bundle and link it to the IR ticket.

Maria (sec-eng): Redaction rules applied by CI-controlled processor (deterministic): `s/email\S*@\S+/[REDACTED_EMAIL]/g`, `s/\b\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}\b/[REDACTED_SSN]/g`, `s/(user_id=)[A-Za-z0-9_-]+/\1[REDACTED_ID]/g`. Sample sanitized line: `2026-03-20T15:02:13Z svc-api request_id=abc123 user_id=[REDACTED_ID] email=[REDACTED_EMAIL] action=get-embedding duration_ms=42`. I'll include redact_test.py to replay.

Ajay (infra): KMS policy snippet (sanitized): principals arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/infra-exporter allowed kms:Encrypt,kms:GenerateDataKey; arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/sec-ops allowed kms:Decrypt. Export object metadata includes kms-key-id and kms-key-version.

Maria (sec-eng): Bundle contents (2026-03-20-rbac-export-bundle.zip): samples/raw_and_sanitized_examples/, manifest.jsonl, manifest.jsonl.sig, iam-change.diff, cloud-audit-event.json, ir-2026-IR-47-timeline.pdf, vuln-triage.csv (CVE -> component -> commit/PR -> remediation -> verification), redact_test.py, gpg_pubkey.asc, audit-note.txt, README-mapping-to-SOC-controls.md (maps files to CC6/CC7).

ops-bot: Upload complete: s3://redwood-compliance/exports/2026-03-20-rbac-window/2026-03-20-rbac-export-bundle.zip (signed).

auditor_jones: Received. We'll validate per-file SHA256s against manifest.jsonl and verify the GPG signature. If we need anything else we'll ping. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

Lina (compliance): Please mark the items as "evidence:prepared" in the compliance tracker once uploaded. Thanks everyone.
